Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion AI POC: evaluation plan & ownership handoff

Hi Evan — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of outcomes
- Orion wants a 2-week hands-on POC to validate inference performance and integration ergonomics for your search/autocomplete workload.
- Primary goals: 1) latency and throughput under representative load; 2) cost-per-query estimates at scale; 3) qualitative evaluation on your 1200-item test set for relevance degradation/regressions.

Draft success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: p95 < 120 ms for 1–4 token output with continuous batching (on provisioned pool).
- Throughput: sustain 120 qps steady-state with <10% tail variance in a 10-minute window.
- Cost: projected compute-only cost <= $0.30 per 1k tokens at target throughput (finalized after job run).
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate on annotated relevance checklist; no critical regression vs baseline.

Evaluation plan (timeboxed)
- Day 0 (this week): environment access + SOW signed; Redwood deploys a dedicated test endpoint.
- Day 1–3: smoke tests, baseline perf runs, KV/prefix cache warm-up.
- Day 4–9: full workload runs (staggered traffic), capture traces, token-level cost estimate.
- Day 10–13: qualitative review with product team, side-by-side eval against current system.
- Day 14: POC readout + next-step decision.

Proposed ownership (RACI-style summary)
- Infra (provisioning, GPU pools, network): Responsible = Aditya Rao; Accountable = Karthik Iyer; Consulted = Ben Carter; Informed = Evan Brooks.
- Integration/app (API routing, client SDK, test harness): Responsible = Ben Carter; Accountable = Evan Brooks (product owner); Consulted = Aditya Rao; Informed = Marissa Cole.
- Security/compliance (data access, logs, audit): Responsible = Marissa Cole (Redwood CS/Infosec liaison); Accountable = Evan Brooks; Consulted = Priya Singh (Orion Sec/Procurement).
- Procurement / commercial (SOW, PO, billing): Responsible = Priya Singh (Orion); Accountable = Karthik Iyer (Redwood AE); Consulted = Marissa Cole; Informed = Ben Carter.

Immediate next steps (action owners & dates)
- Karthik: send draft SOW and cost breakdown (today EOD) — ACTION (Karthik) — target 2027-05-17.
- Priya: confirm procurement milestones and PO path (by 2027-05-19).
- Aditya: prepare ephemeral test pool and share access + minimal runbook (by 2027-05-18).
- Ben: baseline test harness and sample load script; attach redwood-poc-ops-checklist.xlsx (by 2027-05-18).
- Marissa: schedule daily syncs for first week and a 1-hour readout on Day 14 (invites to follow).

Attachments: Orion_POCTest_SOW.pdf (draft), redwood-poc-ops-checklist.xlsx

If this looks good I will send a formal SOW and calendar invites. Evan / Priya — please call out any blockers (security, data residency, procurement cadence) so we can adjust the plan.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks all — I’ll own the customer success cadence and quality validation checkpoints. Proposal:

- Onboarding sync (Day 0): 30 minutes to confirm access, roles, and runbook owners.
- Daily stand (Day 1–5): 15 minutes to unblock infra/integration issues.
- Mid-POC review (Day 8): 45 minutes to review intermediate metrics and candidate examples.
- Final readout (Day 14): 60 minutes for exec summary + deep-dive.

Acceptance checklist I’ll use for the final readout (examples):
- Baseline perf metrics collected for p50/p95/p99.
- Token-cost projection and breakouts.
- 50 flagged queries with acceptance labels from Orion product.
- No open critical security concerns (open non-blocking items documented).

I’ll start scheduling the invites once the SOW is finalized. Happy to run the mid-week demo for Arjun and the ML team.
